Required Other language third-party pack: Maven Surefire Plugin compatible with JUnit 5
Logic Analysis: pom.xml
dependency/build; Maven project descriptor: Java 11 source/target, declares org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter (test scope) and Maven Surefire configuration that enables JUnit 5
src/main/java/Main.java
runtime/bootstrap; thin entrypoint that constructs Game, performs one standalone game.tick() ignoring its boolean result, then prints getters in order: birdY, birdVy, ticks, score, pipes().size()
src/main/java/Game.java

orchestration; central game loop and state machine (RUNNING/GAME_OVER), tick order gravity->integrate->collision->per-pipe scoring->ticks++->spawn at completed tick 100, manages RNG, pipes list, scoring, and exposes canonical API
src/main/java/Bird.java
domain-entity; physics state y and vy; applyGravity() adds +0.5 and clamps to [-10,10]; integrate() adds vy to y; flap() sets vy to -8.0
src/main/java/RNG.java
domain-entity; seeded randomness wrapper with final originalSeed; seed() is non-consuming; nextDouble()/nextInt(int) delegate directly to internal java.util.Random
src/main/java/PipePair.java
domain-entity; obstacle pair with x, width, gapY, gapHeight, speed, and scored flag; move() shifts x left by speed; markScored(); basic getters; off-screen when x+width<0
src/main/java/CollisionDetector.java

pure-rule; static hitBounds(Bird, birdHeight, worldHeight) and hitPipe(Bird, birdWidth, birdHeight, PipePair, worldHeight) implementing exact vertical overlap rules; called after integrate() using unclamped positions
src/main/java/ScoreSystem.java
pure-rule; static passedPipe(birdX, PipePair) returns true exactly once when pipe trailing edge (x+width) is strictly less than birdX; marks pipe scored
src/main/java/GameState.java
domain-entity; enum with RUNNING and GAME_OVER
src/test/java/MainTest.java
automated-test; JUnit 5 tests (2–4) verifying physics fixture, reset+flap fixture, RNG paired streams, and scoring strictness with handcrafted PipePair
Test Scope Plan: Physics fixture: new Game(12345L) initial state; after one tick vy=0.5 and y=worldHeight/2+0.5=300.5
Reset and flap fixture: after reset(12345L), flapBird(), then one tick gives vy=-7.5 and y=292.5
RNG paired streams fixture: RNG a=RNG(98765L), b=RNG(98765L); verify a.seed()==b.seed()==98765L and a.nextDouble()==b.nextDouble() and a.nextInt(100)==b.nextInt(100)
Scoring strictness: with handcrafted PipePair(100.0,50.0,100.0,150.0,3.0), verify ScoreSystem.passedPipe(birdX, pipe) triggers only when pipe.x()+pipe.width() < birdX and marks scored exactly once
